result.summary: The page is largely functional and well-structured. Two minor issues were found: a slightly clipped 'See all' link in the 'Fastest near you' header and inconsistent imagery style between sections.

issues.description: The 'See all' link in the 'Fastest near you' section is positioned at the far right edge and appears clipped, with the trailing letter cut off by the screen boundary.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the 'See all' link is fully visible by adding appropriate right-side padding or aligning it within the section's content bounds.

issues.description: The restaurant images appear to be low-resolution illustrations or placeholders that do not match the photorealistic food imagery used in the 'Popular right now' section, creating visual inconsistency.
issues.suggestion: Use consistent, high-quality food photography across all restaurant cards.
